title: Scriptor: Mana Mode
description: Enables "mana mode" for Scriptor 2.0.0+, allowing you to play with a more typical casting resource.
body:
Adds mana mode to Scriptor Magicae!

This addon replaces the cooldown bar present in Scriptor 2.0.0+ with a basic mana system, letting you cast bigger spells and cast spells in quick succession.

This mod is required on both the client and server, and does not affect entity casting.
